blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Audio-language models (ALMs) integrate acoustic perception with the knowledge encoded in language models, enabling contextual understanding of auditory events. Making these capabilities practical on devices with limited memory and computation motivates our focus on small ALMs with fewer than 200M parameters. We introduce a recipe that brings together architecture, data, and three-stage training to build Mizar, a 159.3M-parameter ALM. Its architecture connects a compact CED-Small audio encoder to SmolLM2-135M through a frequency-merging mapper. With supervision drawn from ReasonAQA, AudioMCQ, and AVQA, the model undergoes three training stages: audio–language alignment (Stage 1), audio-dependent fine-tuning (Stage 2), and post-training (Stage 3) aimed at strengthening weak skills while retaining learned capabilities. Across five random seeds, Mizar achieves mean accuracies of 52.92% on MMAU, 42.42% on MMAR, and 36.02% on ADQA-clean, surpassing the previous best-performing ALM below 200M parameters on all three benchmarks. It also supports local inference on a single CPU: on questions from the MMAU benchmark, the mean latency from opening the audio file to generating a complete answer is 1.09 seconds. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M .
blocks.zh: 音频语言模型(ALMs)将声学感知与语言模型中编码的知识融合在一起,使得能对听觉事件进行上下文的理解. 使这些能力在内存和计算有限的设备上切实可行,促使我们注重小于200M参数的ALM. 我们引入了一种将建筑、数据和三阶段培训结合起来的配方,用于建造Mizar,一个159.3M-参数ALM。 其架构通过频率聚合映射器将紧凑的CED-Small音频编码器与SmolLM2-135M连接. 在ReasonAQA、AudioMCQ和AVQA的监督下,该模式经历了三个培训阶段:音频-语言调整(第1阶段)、音频依赖微调(第2阶段)和培训后(第3阶段),目的是在保留学习能力的同时加强薄弱技能。 在五个随机种子中,Mizar在MMAU上达到52.92%的速率,在MMAR上达到42.42%的速率,在ADQA-clean上达到36.02%的速率,在所有三个基准上都超过了之前表现最好的ALM低于200M参数. 它还支持本地对单个CPU的推论:对于MMAU基准的问题,从打开音频文件到生成完整答案的平均延迟是1.09秒. 密码和检查站可在https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M查询。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Audio-language models (ALMs) combine acoustic perception with the prior knowledge of pretrained language models to provide a unified language reasoning interface for understanding auditory events, their context, and their relationships [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . For environmental sound monitoring and industrial acoustic inspection, local inference supports timely, continuous operation without reliable connectivity while keeping sensitive recordings on the device [ 4 ] . Such deployment requires compact models that fit the memory, compute, and energy budgets of affordable hardware [ 5 ] . We therefore target ALMs with fewer than 200M parameters to support local audio understanding on commodity CPUs and modest edge processors.
blocks.zh: 音频语言模型(ALMs)将声学感知与之前对预训语言模型的了解结合起来,为理解听觉事件,其上下文,及其关系提供统一的语言推理界面[1,2,3]. 对于环境声音监测和工业声学检查,局部推论支持在不可靠连接的情况下及时持续运行,同时保持设备的敏感录音[4]. 这种部署需要紧凑的模型,以适应负担得起的硬件的内存、计算和能源预算[5]。 因此,我们以低于200M参数的ALM为目标,支持本地对商品CPU和适度边缘处理器的音频理解.

blocks.en: Mellow [ 6 ] demonstrates the promise of this scale: with 167M parameters, it achieves competitive audio understanding performance against several much larger models. Despite its strong performance and efficiency, Mellow provides a compelling starting point for investigating whether further gains can be achieved through systematic engineering optimization across three complementary dimensions: dataset curation and filtering, training strategy, and model architecture.
blocks.zh: Mellow [6] 证明了这个比例表的希望:有了167M参数,它相对于几个更大的模型,实现了竞争性的音频理解性能. 尽管Mellow具有很强的性能和效率,但它为调查能否通过系统工程优化在三个相辅相成的方面(数据集的校准和过滤、培训战略和模型架构)取得进一步收益提供了一个令人信服的起点。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce Mizar 1 1 1 The name “Mizar” was inspired by the star for navigation. We hope our model and training recipe can provide guidance for future research and engineering optimization on small audio-language models. , a 159.3M-parameter ALM built through three complementary improvements. (1) Compact audio front-end with frequency merging. We connect a frozen, 21.4M-parameter CED-Small encoder [ 7 ] to SmolLM2-135M [ 8 ] through a frequency-merging mapper, using a 20-second audio input window (Fig. 1 (a)). (2) Enhanced audio supervision. We combine ReasonAQA [ 6 ] , AudioMCQ [ 9 ] , and AVQA [ 10 ] to expand the coverage and diversity of training tasks. (3) Three-stage training with teacher-assisted refinement. Audio instruction learning is followed by audio-dependent fine-tuning and a final refinement that combines answer-position balancing with teacher-assisted four-quadrant sampling to target student model’s weaknesses while rehearsing previously learned skills.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些限制,我们介绍了Mizar 11 1,“Mizar”这个名字是受导航恒星的启发。 我们希望我们的模型和培训配方能够为今后关于小型音频模型的研究和工程优化提供指导。 (1)压缩音频前端与频率合并. 我们用一个20秒的音频输入窗口(图1(a)),通过一个频调图将一个冷冻的21.4M参数CED-Small编码器[7]与SmolLM2-135M[8]连接起来。 (2)加强音频监管. 我们把ReasonAQA[6],AudioMCQ[9],以及AVQA[10]结合起来,以扩大培训任务的覆盖面和多样性. (3)三阶段培训,教师协助完善. 音频教学之后是音频依赖的微调和最后的改进,将答案定位与教师协助的四夸度抽样相结合,以针对学生模型的弱点,同时重温以前学习的技能。

Blue blocks denote model components; gray grids and tokens represent intermediate features. s s separates the 126 audio tokens from the question and option text tokens. (b) Three-stage training. S1 aligns audio and language; S2 strengthens reliance on acoustic evidence; S3 refines skills through rehearsal and answer-position balancing.

blocks.en: Mizar achieves 52.92% mean accuracy on MMAU across five random seeds, exceeding several 7B–13B references. Compared with Mellow under the same evaluation protocol, Mizar achieves relative accuracy gains of 27.61%, 23.31%, and 19.07% on MMAU, MMAR, and ADQA-clean, respectively. To assess its suitability for local deployment, we also evaluate Mizar on CPU inference: using four threads on a single CPU, our model answers the MMAU questions in 1.09 seconds on average.
blocks.zh: 米扎尔在5个随机种子的MMAU上达到52.92%的平均值精度,超过数个7B–13B参考. 与同一评价协议下的Mellow相比,Mizar在MMAU,MMAR和ADQA-clean上的相对准确度分别达到27.61%,23.31%和19.07%. 为了评估它是否适合本地部署,我们还根据CPU推论评价Mizar:用一个CPU上的四个线程,我们的模型平均在1.09秒内回答MMAU的问题.

blocks.en: 2 Architecture, data, and training
blocks.zh: 2 建筑、数据和培训

blocks.en: 2.1 Model architecture
blocks.zh: 2.1 示范结构

blocks.en: Mizar consists of a CED-Small audio encoder, an audio–language mapper of our design, and a SmolLM2-135M language decoder (Fig. 1 (a)). Here, the mapper aligns the audio encoder’s output with the language decoder’s input embedding space. The resulting model contains 159.3M parameters and conditions answer generation on a single audio recording and its accompanying question.
blocks.zh: 米扎尔包含一个CED-Small音频编码器,一个我们设计的音频-语言映射器,以及一个SmolLM2-135M语言解码器(图1(a)). 在此, 映射器将音频编码器的输出与语言解码器的输入嵌入空间对齐 。 由此形成的模型包含159.3M参数和条件在单一音频录音及其伴随的问题上解答生成.

blocks.en: Audio encoder. We use CED-Small [ 7 ] , a Vision Transformer pretrained for audio tagging through consistent ensemble distillation. The encoder divides the log-mel spectrogram into non-overlapping patches and adds temporal and frequency position embeddings. A 12-layer Transformer then produces 384-dimensional patch features. We retain the first 20 seconds of longer recordings and pad shorter recordings to 20 seconds. For a 20-second recording, we encode consecutive spectrogram segments and concatenate their features in temporal order. This gives a feature grid 𝐇 ∈ ℝ 126 × 4 × 384 \mathbf{H}\!\in\!\mathbb{R}^{126\times 4\times 384} , with 126 time positions and four frequency positions, which is passed to the mapper. We discard the classification head of the original CED-Small model and keep the 21.4M-parameter encoder frozen throughout ALM training.
blocks.zh: 音频编码器。 我们使用CED-Small [7],一个视觉变形器 预先训练,通过一致的综艺蒸馏进行音频标记。 编码器将log-mel光谱分为非重叠补丁,并添加时间和频率位置嵌入. 12层变形器然后产生384维的补丁特性. 我们保留了头20秒的更长录音 并将短的录音保留到20秒 对于20秒的录音,我们编码了连续的光谱片段,并按时间顺序将它们的特征整理出来. 这给出了功能网格 H QQ R 126 × 4 × 384\ mathbf{H}\!\in\!\mathb{R}^{126\时间 4\times 384},有126个时间位置和4个频率位置,传递给地图员. 我们放弃了最初CED-Small模型的分类头,并在整个ALM训练中保持21.4M参数编码器的冻结.

blocks.en: Audio–language mapper. Our mapper first combines frequency features at each time position and projects them into the language decoder’s input embedding space. Given the encoder feature grid 𝐇 ∈ ℝ 126 × 4 × 384 \mathbf{H}\in\mathbb{R}^{126\times 4\times 384} , let 𝐇 t , f \mathbf{H}_{t,f} denote the 384-dimensional feature at time position t t and frequency position f f . We concatenate the four frequency features into a 1,536-dimensional vector 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} , then obtain a 576-dimensional representation 𝐮 t \mathbf{u}_{t} through a two-layer MLP f proj f_{\mathrm{proj}} (1,536 → \rightarrow 576 → \rightarrow 576), with GELU and dropout between the layers. Concatenation allows the projection to weight features from different frequency positions separately: 𝐱 t = [ 𝐇 t , 1 ; … ; 𝐇 t , 4 ] , 𝐮 t = f proj ( 𝐱 t ) . \displaystyle\mathbf{x}_{t}=[\mathbf{H}_{t,1};\ldots;\mathbf{H}_{t,4}],\quad\mathbf{u}_{t}=f_{\mathrm{proj}}(\mathbf{x}_{t}). To supplement these local representations with recording-level context, we average the original encoder features over time and frequency, obtaining a 384-dimensional global summary 𝐠 \mathbf{g} . A projection f global f_{\mathrm{global}} maps this summary to 576 dimensions and adds it to every time position. We also add a learned temporal position embedding 𝐏 t \mathbf{P}_{t} and a learned audio-type embedding 𝐞 audio \mathbf{e}_{\mathrm{audio}} shared across all positions. These 576-dimensional vectors form the contextualized representation 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} : 𝐠 \displaystyle\mathbf{g} = Mean t , f ( 𝐇 ) , 𝐠 audio = f global ( 𝐠 ) , \displaystyle=\operatorname{Mean}_{t,f}(\mathbf{H}),\quad\mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{audio}}=f_{\mathrm{global}}(\mathbf{g}), 𝐡 t \displaystyle\mathbf{h}_{t} = 𝐮 t + 𝐠 audio + 𝐏 t + 𝐞 audio . \displaystyle=\mathbf{u}_{t}+\mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{audio}}+\mathbf{P}_{t}+\mathbf{e}_{\mathrm{audio}}. Here, LN \operatorname{LN} denotes layer normalization [ 17 ] . The mapper thus aligns features at 126 time positions with the language decoder’s input embedding space, producing the audio token sequence 𝐙 ∈ ℝ 126 × 576 \mathbf{Z}\in\mathbb{R}^{126\times 576} . The mapper contains 3.37M parameters, and its computational cost is evaluated in Sec. 3.6 . 𝐳 t \displaystyle\mathbf{z}_{t} = 𝐡 t + f refine ( LN ( 𝐡 t ) ) , 𝐙 = [ 𝐳 1 ; … ; 𝐳 126 ] . \displaystyle=\mathbf{h}_{t}+f_{\mathrm{refine}}(\operatorname{LN}(\mathbf{h}_{t})),\quad\mathbf{Z}=[\mathbf{z}_{1};\ldots;\mathbf{z}_{126}].

blocks.en: Language decoder. We adopt SmolLM2-135M [ 8 ] , a pretrained decoder-only Transformer with 30 layers, a hidden width of 576, and grouped-query attention. Its pretrained language knowledge helps interpret questions and connect audio to answers. We tokenize the question and options using SmolLM2’s tokenizer. The decoder receives the audio tokens, a separator token s s , and the embedded text tokens, then generates the answer autoregressively.
blocks.zh: 语言解码器. 我们采用SmolLM2-135M [8],一种预装解码器唯一的变形器,有30层,隐藏宽度576,并组组-query注意. 它经过预先训练的语言知识有助于解释问题,并将音频与答案连接起来. 我们用 SmolLM2 的标注器来表示问题和选项。 解码器接收音频符号,一个分隔符符号 s,以及嵌入式文本符号,然后自动生成答案.

blocks.en: 2.2 Data and three-stage training
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据和三阶段培训

blocks.en: Throughout training, we keep CED-Small frozen, train the randomly initialized mapper, and fully fine-tune SmolLM2-135M using answer-token cross-entropy. Training proceeds in three stages, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (b).
blocks.zh: 在整个训练过程中,我们保持CED-Small的冷冻,训练随机初始化的映射仪,并使用解答-token交叉切换来完全微调SmolLM2-135M. 如图1(b)所示,培训分三个阶段进行。

blocks.en: Stage 1: audio instruction learning. We combine 756,968 ReasonAQA examples [ 6 ] , covering multiple-choice, open-answer, captioning, and binary tasks, with 571,008 AudioMCQ direct-answer examples [ 9 ] . In addition, we randomly sample 150,000 chain-of-thought (CoT) examples from AudioMCQ to encourage the model to learn from explicit reasoning steps and strengthen its reasoning ability. The resulting mixture contains 1,477,976 supervision rows, with multiple examples potentially sharing the same recording. We train for three epochs to align audio and language and adapt the decoder to audio tasks.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:音频教学。 我们合并了756,968个ReasonAQA例子[6],涵盖多选择,开放回答,标题和二进制任务,共571,008个 AudioMCQ直接回答例子 [9]. 此外,我们随机抽取AudioMCQ的15万个思维链(COT)例子,鼓励模型从明确的推理步骤中学习,加强其推理能力. 由此产生的混合物包含1,477,976条监督行,其中多个例子可能共享相同的记录. 我们为三个时代进行训练,使音频和语言一致,并使解码器适应音频任务.

blocks.en: Stage 2: audio-dependent fine-tuning. He et al. [ 9 ] show that further fine-tuning a trained ALM on strongly audio-dependent examples improves performance. Following this finding, we construct an audio-dependent fine-tuning dataset by combining strongAC with AVQA [ 10 ] . strongAC is a subset of AudioMCQ selected for low reference-model answer accuracy when audio is replaced with silence. From AVQA, we retain only the sound (audio-only) and both (audio–visual) subsets, excluding visual-only questions. Together, these provide 256,077 strongAC and 33,875 AVQA examples. We fine-tune on audio paired with question and option text, without video, training the model to generate the complete target answer using answer-token cross-entropy. In total, 57,984 examples from this 289,952-row pool are used to fine-tune the model.
blocks.zh: 阶段2:音频依赖微调. 他等编. [9] 显示在强烈依赖音频的例子上进一步微调训练有素的ALM可以提高性能. 根据这一发现,我们通过将强式AC与AVQA[10]强式结合,构建了一套依赖音频的微调数据集. AC是AudioMCQ的一个子集,在音频被静音取代时被选为低参考模型的答案精度. 从AVQA来看,我们只保留声音(只有音频)和两个(音频-视觉)子集,不包括只视觉的问题. 它们共同提供了256 077个强AC和33 875个AVQA的例子。 我们在音频上微调与提问文本和选项文本对齐,不带视频,训练模型使用答案-token cross-entropy生成完整的目标答案. 共有57,984个例子从这个289,952-row池中被用来微调模型.

blocks.en: Stage 3: refinement with answer-position balancing and rehearsal. We observe that the checkpoint obtained from Stage 2 favors particular answer positions among A–D, motivating a refinement stage that reduces this preference. Using the Stage 2 data pool, we cyclically reorder the options so that correct answers are balanced across the four positions while preserving question and answer identity. This addresses the option-position sensitivity observed in language models [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 第3阶段:完善答案定位平衡和排练。 我们注意到,从第二阶段获得的检查站有利于A-D之间的特殊答复立场,这促使有一个完善阶段,以减少这种偏好。 利用第二阶段数据库,我们周期性地重新排序选项,以便在保留问答身份的同时,在四个位置上平衡正确的答案。 这涉及到语言模型中观察到的选项位置敏感性[18].

blocks.en: To target student weaknesses while retaining previously learned skills, we design a teacher-assisted four-quadrant sampling strategy. We partition the Stage 2 data pool according to the correctness of a strong teacher (AudioMCQ’s fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Omni [ 9 ] ) and the Stage 2 Mizar student. Both models are evaluated under all four cyclic option orderings; a question is considered consistently solved only if all four answers are correct. As summarized in Table 2 , the mixture emphasizes teacher-solved student weaknesses while retaining examples of shared and student-specific strengths, with a small share of questions that neither model consistently solves.
blocks.zh: 为了针对学生的弱点,同时保留以前学到的技能,我们设计了一个由教师协助的四水分抽样战略。 根据强师(AudioMCQ’s精细校正的Quen2.5-Omni[9])和二期米扎尔学生的正确性, 这两种模式在所有四个循环选择顺序下都得到评价;只有在所有四个答案都正确的情况下,一个问题才被视为始终如一地得到解决。 如表2所概述,混合体强调教师-解决学生的弱点,同时保留共同和学生特长的例子,少数问题没有模式一致解决。

blocks.en: Table 2: Teacher-assisted four-quadrant sampling for Stage 3. For each model, “Yes” means correct answers under all four cyclic option orderings; “No” means at least one incorrect answer. Share is the sampling proportion of each group.
blocks.zh: 表2:第3阶段由教师协助的四位数抽样,对于每个模型,“是”是指在所有四个循环选择中正确回答;“否”是指至少一个错误回答。 份额是每个组的抽样比例。

blocks.en: In total, 12,800 examples are used to post-train the model in Stage 3. Sec. 3.4 evaluates the effects of answer-position balancing and four-quadrant sampling strategy through detailed analysis.
blocks.zh: 共使用了12 800个实例,用于在 " 阶段 " 中培训模型 3个 第3.4条通过详细分析,评价答案位置平衡和四位体取样战略的效果。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments and analysis
blocks.zh: 3 实验和分析

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We use MMAU test-mini (1,000 questions) as the validation set to select all hyperparameters and checkpoints across the three training stages, with detailed settings documented in our open-source implementation. We evaluate on MMAU (MMAU-v05.15.25; 9,000 questions) [ 19 ] , MMAR (1,000 questions) [ 20 ] , and ADQA-clean (1,577 questions) [ 21 ] , which excludes 30 questions sharing audios with the validation set. An audio-level audit confirmed no overlap between the training, validation, and test sets.
blocks.zh: 我们使用MMAU测试-mini(1,000个问题)作为验证装置,选择跨越三个培训阶段的所有超参数和检查站,详细设置记录在我们开源执行中. 我们评价MMAU(MMAU-v05.15.25;9000个问题)[19],MMAR(1,000个问题)[20],ADQA-clean(1,577个问题)[21],不包括30个与验证集共享音频的问题. 音频层面的审计证实培训、验证和测试组之间没有重叠。

blocks.en: Models generate answers with greedy decoding in FP32 and a 300-token limit. MMAU Test predictions are generated locally and scored by the official evaluation service; other benchmarks use their official evaluators. We report accuracy and its unweighted three-benchmark mean (Test-3). Post-training results report mean ± \pm sample SD across five seeds sharing one Stage 1/Stage 2 initializer.
blocks.zh: 模型在FP32中以贪婪的解码和300托肯极限生成答案. 毛里塔尼亚 测试预测在当地产生,由官方评价服务机构评分;其他基准使用其官方评价人员. 我们报告准确性及其未加权的三个基准平均值(Test-3)。 培训后结果报告是指在共享一个阶段1/第2阶段初始化器的5个种子中, ±\pm样本SD。

blocks.en: Table 3: Benchmark accuracy (%). Mizar reports mean ± \pm sample SD across five post-training seeds with shared Stage 1/2 initializers. Mean averages the three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表3:基准准确性(%)。 Mizar报告指使用共享的阶段1/2初始器在五个训练后种子上采样SD ±\pm. 平均值为三个基准。

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmark results
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准结果

blocks.en: Mizar improves over locally reevaluated Mellow on all three benchmarks (Table 3 ), gaining 11.45% on MMAU Test, 8.02% on MMAR, and 5.77% on ADQA-clean. The extensive comparison in Table 1 places its MMAU performance above several 7B–13B models while using 159.3M parameters. Stage 2 raises the Test-3 mean from 40.01% to 42.38%, supporting audio-dependent adaptation after audio instruction learning. Stage 3 further increases it to 43.78%, with improvements across all three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 米扎尔改进了当地重新评估 MMAU测试率为11.45%,MMAR测试率为8.02%,ADQA清洁率为5.77%。 表1中的广泛比较将其MMAU的性能置于几个7B-13B模型之上,同时使用了159.3M参数. 第2阶段将测试-3的平均值从40.01%提高到42.38%,支持音频教学后进行依赖音频的适应。 第3阶段进一步将其提高到43.78%,这三项基准都有所改善。

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation on Stage 1 and 2 Components
blocks.zh: 3.3 第一阶段和第二阶段的缺陷

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation on Stage 1 and 2 components. Scores are accuracy (%); Mean averages the three benchmarks. C1/C2 and Mellow-native use single-seed runs at the same training endpoint as Mizar (S1). B1/B2 also change the mapper; B2 exceeds 200M parameters.
blocks.zh: 表4:第1和第2阶段部分的拨款情况。 得分是准确性(%);平均平均数是三个基准。 C1/C2和Mellow-native使用单籽在与Mizar(S1)相同的训练终点运行. B1/B2也改变了映射器;B2超过了200M参数.

blocks.en: Table 4 compares Stage 1 data recipes, front-end configurations, and mapper variants, followed by Stage 2 audio-dependent fine-tuning. For Stage 1, removing the 150K AudioMCQ CoT examples (A1) lowers the Test-3 mean by 2.19 points, while using ReasonAQA alone (A2) lowers it by 6.79 points. The full mixture (Mizar S1) performs better on MMAU and ADQA-clean, although A1 is slightly better on MMAR. These results support combining audio supervision with CoT examples. For the audio encoder comparisons, CED-Small achieves a higher mean than HTS-AT [ 22 ] and BEATs [ 23 ] . The B1/B2 variants also change the mapper, so these results compare encoder–mapper configurations rather than isolated encoder effects. Compared with random sampling, Stage 2 fine-tuning on strongAC and AVQA improves all three benchmarks, raising Test-3 from 40.10% to 42.38%.
blocks.zh: 表4 比较 第1阶段数据配方,前端配置,以及映射变体,之后是第2阶段音频依赖的微调. 对于第1阶段,移除150K AudioMCQ CoT 例(A1),将Test-3的平均值降低2.19分,而仅使用ReasonAQA(A2)则降低6.79分. 全混合物(Mizar S1)在MMAU和ADQA-clean上表现较好,虽然在MMAR上A1稍好. 这些结果支持将音频监督与CoT实例相结合。 对于音频编码器比较,CED-Small实现比HTS-AT [22] 和BEATs [23] 更高的平均值. B1/B2变体也改变了映射器,因此这些结果比较了编码器-映射器的配置而不是孤立的编码器效果. 与随机抽样相比,第二阶段在强AC和AVQA上的微调改进了所有三个基准,将测试-3从40.10%提高到42.38%.

blocks.en: Mapper ablations. With the CED-Small encoder, training data and settings, and 20-second input preprocessing fixed, we compare three mappers. Concat (C1; 1.22M parameters) concatenates the four 384-dimensional frequency features at each time position into a 1,536-dimensional vector, applies a linear projection to 576 dimensions, and then a residual layer and layer normalization. Mean (C2; 0.55M) averages the four frequency features into a 384-dimensional vector before projection, retaining the same subsequent structure. We compare these variants with our 3.37M-parameter mapper described in Sec. 2.1 . With the same single-seed runs, our mapper achieves a Test-3 mean of 40.01%, compared with 39.27% for Concat and 39.10% for Mean. The largest gains occur on MMAU, where our mapper reaches 49.03%, versus 46.93% and 46.94%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 地图喷发 随着CED-Small编码器,培训数据和设置,以及20秒输入预处理固定,我们比较了三个映射器. Concat(C1;1.22M参数)将每次位置上的4个384维频率特征缩合成1,536维向量,对576维进行线性投影,然后进行残余层和层态化. 平均值(C2;0.55M)在投影前将四个频率特征平均成一个384维的矢量,保留同样的后续结构. 我们把这些变体与 Sec 中描述的3.37M参数映射仪进行比较。 2.1. 国家 同样的单一种子运行,我们的地图员实现了40.01%的测试-3平均值,而Concat为39.27%,Mean为39.10%。 最大的收益出现在MMAU上,我们的绘图器分别达到49.03%和46.93%。

blocks.en: Transfer to Mellow’s architecture. We retrain Mellow’s native architecture using our expanded Stage 1 data and training recipe (Mellow-native). Its single-seed Test-3 mean reaches 39.04%, compared with 35.37% for the released Mellow checkpoint in Table 3 . MMAU and MMAR accuracies increase from 41.47% to 48.21% and from 34.40% to 38.60%, respectively, while ADQA-clean remains nearly unchanged (30.25% versus 30.31%). These results support the value of our expanded dataset and training recipe beyond the Mizar architecture.
blocks.zh: 转至Mellow的建筑. 我们利用扩展后的第一阶段数据和培训食谱(Mellow-native)重新培训Mellow的本土建筑。 它的单一种子测试-3平均达到39.04%,而表3中已释放的Mellow检查站为35.37%。 MMAU和MMAR的速率分别从41.47%增至48.21%和34.40%增至38.60%,而ADQA-clean则几乎保持不变(30.25%对30.31%)。 这些成果支持了我们超越米扎尔架构的扩大数据集和培训配方的价值。

blocks.en: 3.4 Post-training analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训后分析

blocks.en: Table 5: Stage 3 post-training at the validation-selected step 200. Scores are mean ± \pm sample standard deviation across five seeds. Mean averages the three benchmarks. Mizar (Q2) combines quadrant selection with answer-position balancing.
blocks.zh: 表5:第3阶段,在选定的200阶段进行验证后培训。 分数为平均±\pm样本标准差,跨越5个种子. 平均值为三个基准。 米扎尔(Q2)将四象限选择与答位平衡相结合.

blocks.en: We compare four continuations from the same Stage 2 model (Table 5 ). R1 uses randomly sampled questions in their original option order. R2 uses exactly the same questions in the same training order, changing only the option positions to balance the correct-answer distribution across A–D. Q1 applies quadrant selection using correctness in the original option order, whereas Q2 uses correctness across all four cyclic orderings and balances answer positions. Thus, the Q1/Q2 comparison changes both the screening rule and option presentation. All four continuations share the training pool, sample budget, optimizer, and ground-truth cross-entropy objective; R2 and Q2 also share the same sequence of correct-answer positions.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了相同的第二阶段模式(表5)中的四个续作。 R1在最初的选项顺序中使用随机抽样的问题. R2在同一个训练顺序中使用完全相同的问题,只改变选项位置,以平衡整个A–D的正确答案分布. Q1使用原选项顺序中的正确性来应用四象限选择,而Q2则对所有四个循环顺序和平衡答案位置使用正确性. 因此,Q1/Q2比较既改变了筛选规则,也改变了选项列报。 所有四个续作都共享培训人才库,样本预算,优化器,以及地面真实跨入目标;R2和Q2也共享相同顺序的正确回答位置.

blocks.en: Random continuation alone (R1) yields a Test-3 mean of 42.10%, slightly below Stage 2 (42.38%). Balancing answer positions on the same questions (R2) raises the mean to 43.04%, improving all three benchmarks, with the largest gain on MMAU. Under balanced presentation, teacher-assisted quadrant selection (Q2) further raises the mean to 43.78%, outperforming R2 by 0.51, 0.86, and 0.88 points on MMAU, MMAR, and ADQA-clean, respectively. Q1 also improves over R1, while Q2 achieves the best result on every benchmark. Together, these comparisons support answer-position balancing and teacher-assisted selection as useful components of Stage 3.
blocks.zh: 单是随机延续(R1),试验-3的平均值为42.10%,略低于第二阶段(42.38%)。 平衡对相同问题(R2)的回答立场将平均比例提高到43.04%,改善了所有三个基准,对MMAU收益最大. 在均衡的列报方式下,教师协助的四方选择(问题2)进一步将平均率提高到43.78%,在MMAU、MMAR和ADQA-clean上分别比R2高0.51、0.86和0.88分。 Q1也比R1有所改进,而Q2则在每个基准上取得最佳结果. 这些比较共同支持平衡答案位置和教师协助选择,作为第三阶段的有用组成部分。

blocks.en: 3.5 Dependence on acoustic input
blocks.zh: 3.5 对音响输入的依赖

blocks.en: Table 6: Accuracy (%) with original, silent, and replacement audio under the same configuration. Parentheses show changes from original-audio accuracy in percentage points ( Δ \Delta ). Mizar reports means across five seeds; Mellow uses its released checkpoint with plen=256 to match Mizar’s setting.
blocks.zh: 表6:相同配置下具有原声,静音,替换音频的精确度(%). 括号显示从原声精度变化的百分点(QQ\Delta ). Mizar报告指五种种子;

blocks.en: To assess how much each model benefits from the accompanying audio, we keep the questions and options fixed and replace the recording with either silence or an unrelated one from the same domain. We compare Mizar and Mellow under the same protocol (Table 6 ). Mellow’s original-audio scores are recomputed under this diagnostic protocol for a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 为了评估每个模型从伴随的音频中获得多少好处,我们保持问题和选项的固定,并用沉默或同一个领域无关的录音替换录音. 根据同一议定书,我们比较Mizar和Mellow(表6)。 Mellow的原声分数在此诊断协议下重新计算,

blocks.en: Both interventions reduce accuracy on every benchmark, with larger drops for Mizar than for Mellow. On MMAU, silence and replacement reduce Mizar’s accuracy by 8.23 and 9.24 points, compared with 5.80 and 6.51 points for Mellow. The same pattern holds on MMAR and ADQA-clean, indicating a larger contribution from the original audio to Mizar’s answers under this protocol. Mizar also remains more accurate under both interventions, suggesting that its advantage combines stronger use of acoustic evidence with capabilities that remain useful when the original audio is unavailable.
blocks.zh: 这两种干预措施都降低了每个基准的准确性,Mizar比Mellow的下降幅度更大。 在MMAU上,沉默和替换将米扎尔的精确度降低了8.23和9.24分,而梅卢则降低了5.80和6.51分. MMAR和ADQA-clean也有同样的模式,表明原始音频对Mizar根据这项协议的答案有更大的贡献。 米扎尔在这两种发言中也仍然比较准确,表明其优点是将更有力地使用声学证据与在原始音频无法使用时仍然有用的能力结合起来.

blocks.en: 3.6 Computational cost and CPU inference
blocks.zh: 3.6 计算费用和CPU推论

blocks.en: Table 7: Estimated average GFLOPs on MMAU test-mini using 20-second audio inputs.
blocks.zh: 表7:使用20秒音频输入的MMAU测试最小度的GFLOP估计数。

blocks.en: We compare Mizar and Mellow’s GFLOPs on MMAU test-mini with 20-second inputs (Table 7 ). We account for acoustic feature extraction, projection into audio tokens, decoder processing of the input prefix, and answer generation with a KV cache. Total uses the observed answer lengths with a 64-token cap and exclude audio preprocessing and runtime overhead. This compute comparison uses a separate input protocol from Mellow’s benchmark evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们比较米萨尔和梅柳关于MMAU测试-mini的GFLOP和20秒输入(表7). 我们负责声学特性提取,投影到音频符号,输入前缀的解码处理,以及使用KV缓存的答录生成. 总计使用64个顶盖的可观察到的答题长度,不包括音频预处理和运行时间间接费用。 这种计算比较使用与Mellow的基准评价不同的输入协议.

blocks.en: Compared with Mellow, Mizar reduces computation from 118.95 to 113.22 GFLOPs per input, a 4.82% decrease. The audio–language interface contributes 73.06% of this saving, with its cost falling from 4.83 to 0.64 GFLOPs. Encoder costs remain similar, while decoder input processing dominates both models. The overall saving is therefore smaller than the reduction in interface computation.
blocks.zh: 与Mellow相比,Mizar将计算从每个输入的118.95GFLOP减少至113.22GFLOP,下降4.82%. 音频-语言界面占这一节省的73.06%,其成本从4.83降至0.64 GFLOPs. 编码器的成本依然相似,而解码器输入处理则主导两种模型. 因此,总的节省比接口计算减少少。

blocks.en: In addition, we measure batch-1 inference on an AMD EPYC 7542 server CPU using four threads, FP32, and no quantization. Across 100 task-stratified MMAU Test questions, each repeated three times after warmup, Mizar takes 0.636 seconds on average from opening the audio file to the first token and 1.094 seconds to the complete answer (95th percentile: 1.366 seconds). Peak process memory is 1.66 GiB, including framework initialization. These measurements demonstrate that Mizar enables local inference on a single CPU using only four threads.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们用4个线程(FP32)对AMD EMYC 7542服务器CPU进行批次-1推论,不进行量化. 超过100项任务批准的MMAU 测试问题,每一次热身后重复三次,米扎尔从打开音频文件到第一令牌平均需要0.636秒,从1.094秒到完整答案(95百分位数:1.366秒). 高峰过程内存为1.66 GiB,包括框架初始化. 这些测量表明,Mizar能够仅使用四个线程对单个CPU进行局部推论.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We present Mizar, a 159.3M-parameter audio-language model that demonstrates the potential for strong audio understanding under a compact parameter budget. By bringing together a compact audio architecture, diverse supervision, and staged adaptation, our recipe enables Mizar to surpass the previous best-performing ALM below 200M parameters across MMAU, MMAR, and ADQA-clean benchmarks. Our experiments show how audio instruction learning and audio-dependent fine-tuning establish a foundation that answer-position balancing and teacher-assisted selection further strengthen. Mizar also runs on a single CPU, making local inference feasible with limited computing resources.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Mizar,一种159.3M参数的音频语言模型,显示在紧凑的参数预算下有强大的音频理解潜力。 通过整合一个紧凑的音频架构、不同的监督和分阶段的调整,我们的食谱使Mizar能够超越以往最佳的AMM低于200M参数的MMAU、MMAR和ADQA清洁基准。 我们的实验显示,音频教学学习和音频依赖微调如何奠定一个基础,使答案位置平衡和教师协助选择得到进一步加强。 米扎尔还运行在单一的CPU上,使得局部推论在有限的计算资源下是可行的.
